The State Of West Bengal & Ors vs Based Mondal on 17
January, 2024
Author: Arijit Banerjee

Bench: Arijit Banerjee
13. 17.01.2024
 Court No.6
 (Tanmoy)
 Ia No: Can/3/2023
 The State of West Bengal & Ors.

-Versus-
 Based Mondal
 In
 Mat 1492 of 2023
 Mr. Soumitra Bandyopadhyay, Adv.,
 Mr. Priyabrata Batabyal, Adv.
 ...for the applicants.
 Mr. Amit Kumar Pan, Adv.,
 Ms. Tanusri Santra, Adv.
 ...for the respondent/
writ petitioner.

This application has been taken out on behalf of the State of West Bengal in an appeal which was disposed of along with two other appeals by a judgment and order dated August 22, 2023, passed by a co-ordinate Bench.
The land of the respondent/writ petitioner was taken over by the State Government upon initiation of acquisition proceedings.
The proceedings were not carried to their logical conclusion.
Not having received compensation, the writ petitioner approached this Court by filing three writ petitions being WPA 31106 of 2014, WPA 31108 of 2014 and WPA 31110 of 2014.

Those writ petitions were disposed of by a learned Judge of this Court by a judgment and order dated April 11, 2023, the operative portion whereof reads as follows:-
"...12.

Therefore, there is no other option but to initiate of a fresh proceeding under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transperency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 for regularizing the process of acquisition and for paying compensation to the owners of the land or their representatives.

13. In view of the above and in the interest of justice, this Court directs the respondent authorities to initiate appropriate proceedings under the Act of 2013 for The State Of West Bengal & Ors vs Based Mondal on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/66479809/
1 regularizing the acquisition of the land in question, within a period of four weeks from the date of communication of this order, so that compensation can be paid to the land losers or other representatives at the earliest..."

sentences.text:
The State preferred three appeals against the said judgment and order being MAT 1492 of 2023,
MAT 1532 of 2023 and MAT 1533 of 2023.
By a judgment and order dated August 22, 2023, a co- ordinate Bench disposed of the three appeals without interfering with the judgment and order of the learned Single Judge.

Therefore, the order of the learned Single Judge having been upheld by the Division Bench, the State is under an obligation to initiate proceedings under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
However, the State says by way of the present application that during the pendency of the three appeals, the respondent/writ petitioner made an application/ representation dated August 14, 2023, to The Secretary & Land Reforms Commissioner, L&L.R. and R.R.&R. Department (Annexure "R/3"),
requesting the State Government to Award compensation pursuant to Direct Purchase Policy of the State.
Learned Advocate for the applicants says that the State should be granted liberty to initiate appropriate proceedings under Direct Purchase Policy.

Mr. Pan, learned Advocate for the respondent/writ petitioner, says that the recalcitrant attitude of the State Government compelled his client, who is about 76 years old and has been deprived of due compensation for a long time, to make the aforesaid representation out of desperation.
We appreciate what Mr. Pan is trying to say.
However, the fact remains that the writ petitioner has approached the State Government for action being taken under Direct Purchase Policy.
Accordingly, we grant liberty to the State Government to purchase the land of the writ petitioner following the Direct Purchase Policy.
Such transaction must be completed within six weeks from date.
In default, the order of the learned Single Judge, as upheld by the Division Bench, will have to be implemented by the State.
The application being IA No: CAN/3/2023 is disposed of.

Urgent photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, be made available to the parties, upon compliance with all requisite formalities.
(Arijit Banerjee, J.) (Apurba Sinha Ray, J.)
